mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and a temperature of 80 degrees over at Verona City Hall. Keep an eye on the sky tonight, because the Waxing Gibbous moon will be joined by the ISS, which will be visible for 5 minutes starting at 9:37 PM, rising near Cross Plains and traveling toward Oregon, reaching about halfway up the sky.

The City Clerk's office has wrapped up entries for the I Voted sticker contest. Verona students from kindergarten through high school submitted their original artwork, and the community will have the chance to vote on the top designs from July 28 through August 7 to decide what appears on our ballots this November.

We have a busy couple of days ahead! Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking further ahead, join us for trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Louie on Tuesday, or check out the Downtown Farmer's Market and Pizza night on Wednesday.

In our weekly police report, we look back to Monday, July 13, when officers were called to assist a driver who was found with their vehicle stuck on a large rock. The 36-year-old driver was subsequently arrested for an O-W-I offense.
Do not miss out on today's flavor, Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. Culver's is open until 10:30 PM tonight, giving you plenty of time to stop by for a scoop before they close.
